question: Compare prognostic genes in the HPA TCGA Kidney Renal Clear Cell Carcinoma and Lung Adenocarcinoma cohorts. Give favourable and unfavourable gene counts for each, same-direction and opposite-direction overlap counts, and the number of genes prognostic in both that are FDA approved drug targets or secreted to blood. Among genes favourable in both, rank twelve by the larger of their two favourable prognostic p-values, smallest first, ties by Ensembl ID. Give both p-values, the evidence categories, kidney and lung consensus nTPM and protein classes. Draw direction-overlap bars, a two-cancer p-value scatter and an RNA heatmap; provide the tables. If a requested ranked list has fewer eligible members, return every eligible member and state the count. Use Ensembl genes present in the HPA master table as the gene universe and break all gene-ranking ties by Ensembl ID.

FROM proteinatlas;"}

tool_uses.input:
{"query":"SELECT 
  CASE 
    WHEN "Cancer prognostics - Kidney Renal Clear Cell Carcinoma (TCGA)" LIKE '%prognostic favorable%' THEN 'favourable'
    WHEN "Cancer prognostics - Kidney Renal Clear Cell Carcinoma (TCGA)" LIKE '%prognostic unfavorable%' THEN 'unfavourable'
    ELSE 'not_prognostic'
  END AS kidney_status,
  CASE 
    WHEN "Cancer prognostics - Lung Adenocarcinoma (TCGA)" LIKE '%prognostic favorable%' THEN 'favourable'
    WHEN "Cancer prognostics - Lung Adenocarcinoma (TCGA)" LIKE '%prognostic unfavorable%' THEN 'unfavourable'
    ELSE 'not_prognostic'
  END AS lung_status,
  COUNT(*) AS count
FROM proteinatlas
GROUP BY kidney_status, lung_status
ORDER BY kidney_status, lung_status;"}

{"query":"WITH prog_both AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM proteinatlas
  WHERE ("Cancer prognostics - Kidney Renal Clear Cell Carcinoma (TCGA)" LIKE '%prognostic favorable%' 
      OR "Cancer prognostics - Kidney Renal Clear Cell Carcinoma (TCGA)" LIKE '%prognostic unfavorable%')
    AND ("Cancer prognostics - Lung Adenocarcinoma (TCGA)" LIKE '%prognostic favorable%' 
      OR "Cancer prognostics - Lung Adenocarcinoma (TCGA)" LIKE '%prognostic unfavorable%')
)
SELECT 
  COUNT(*) as total_prog_both,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN "Protein class" LIKE '%FDA approved drug targets%' THEN 1 END) as fda_targets,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN "Secretome location" = 'Secreted to blood' THEN 1 END) as secreted_to_blood,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN "Protein class" LIKE '%FDA approved drug targets%' OR "Secretome location" = 'Secreted to blood' THEN 1 END) as fda_or_secreted,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN "Protein class" LIKE '%FDA approved drug targets%' AND "Secretome location" = 'Secreted to blood' THEN 1 END) as fda_and_secreted
FROM prog_both;"}

tool_uses.input:
{"query":"WITH genes AS (
  SELECT 
    p.Ensembl,
    p.Gene,
    p."Cancer prognostics - Kidney Renal Clear Cell Carcinoma (TCGA)" AS pa_k,
    p."Cancer prognostics - Lung Adenocarcinoma (TCGA)" AS pa_l,
    COALESCE(TRY_CAST(ck."potential prognostic - favorable" AS DOUBLE), TRY_CAST(ck."validated prognostic - favorable" AS DOUBLE)) AS p_k_num,
    COALESCE(TRY_CAST(cl."potential prognostic - favorable" AS DOUBLE), TRY_CAST(cl."validated prognostic - favorable" AS DOUBLE)) AS p_l_num,
    TRY_CAST(regexp_extract(p."Cancer prognostics - Kidney Renal Clear Cell Carcinoma (TCGA)", '\((.+)\)', 1) AS DOUBLE) AS pa_p_k,
    TRY_CAST(regexp_extract(p."Cancer prognostics - Lung Adenocarcinoma (TCGA)", '\((.+)\)', 1) AS DOUBLE) AS pa_p_l
  FROM proteinatlas p
  LEFT JOIN cancer_prognostic_data ck ON p.Ensembl = ck.Gene AND ck.Cancer = 'Kidney Renal Clear Cell Carcinoma (TCGA)'
  LEFT JOIN cancer_prognostic_data cl ON p.Ensembl = cl.Gene AND cl.Cancer = 'Lung Adenocarcinoma (TCGA)'
  WHERE (p."Cancer prognostics - Kidney Renal Clear Cell Carcinoma (TCGA)" LIKE '%prognostic favorable%')
    AND (p."Cancer prognostics - Lung Adenocarcinoma (TCGA)" LIKE '%prognostic favorable%')
)
SELECT 
  Ensembl,
  Gene,
  p_k_num,
  p_l_num,
  GREATEST(p_k_num, p_l_num) AS max_p_num,
  pa_p_k,
  pa_p_l,
  GREATEST(pa_p_k, pa_p_l) AS max_pa_p
FROM genes
ORDER BY max_p_num ASC, Ensembl ASC
LIMIT 15;"}

{"query":"WITH fav_both AS (
  SELECT 
    p.Ensembl,
    p.Gene,
    regexp_replace(p."Cancer prognostics - Kidney Renal Clear Cell Carcinoma (TCGA)", ' \(.*', '') as k_cat,
    regexp_replace(p."Cancer prognostics - Lung Adenocarcinoma (TCGA)", ' \(.*', '') as l_cat,
    COALESCE(TRY_CAST(ck."potential prognostic - favorable" AS DOUBLE), TRY_CAST(ck."validated prognostic - favorable" AS DOUBLE)) AS p_k,
    COALESCE(TRY_CAST(cl."potential prognostic - favorable" AS DOUBLE), TRY_CAST(cl."validated prognostic - favorable" AS DOUBLE)) AS p_l,
    p.Evidence,
    p."Protein class"
  FROM proteinatlas p
  LEFT JOIN cancer_prognostic_data ck ON p.Ensembl = ck.Gene AND ck.Cancer = 'Kidney Renal Clear Cell Carcinoma (TCGA)'
  LEFT JOIN cancer_prognostic_data cl ON p.Ensembl = cl.Gene AND cl.Cancer = 'Lung Adenocarcinoma (TCGA)'
  WHERE (p."Cancer prognostics - Kidney Renal Clear Cell Carcinoma (TCGA)" LIKE '%prognostic favorable%')
    AND (p."Cancer prognostics - Lung Adenocarcinoma (TCGA)" LIKE '%prognostic favorable%')
)
SELECT 
  fb.Ensembl,
  fb.Gene,
  fb.p_k,
  fb.k_cat,
  fb.p_l,
  fb.l_cat,
  GREATEST(fb.p_k, fb.p_l) as max_p,
  fb.Evidence,
  rk.nTPM as kidney_ntpm,
  rl.nTPM as lung_ntpm,
  fb."Protein class"
FROM fav_both fb
LEFT JOIN rna_tissue_consensus rk ON fb.Ensembl = rk.Gene AND rk.Tissue = 'kidney'
LEFT JOIN rna_tissue_consensus rl ON fb.Ensembl = rl.Gene AND rl.Tissue = 'lung'
ORDER BY max_p ASC, fb.Ensembl ASC
LIMIT 12;"}

WITH genes AS (
  SELECT 
    p.Ensembl,
    p.Gene,
    p."Cancer prognostics - Kidney Renal Clear Cell Carcinoma (TCGA)" AS pa_k,
    p."Cancer prognostics - Lung Adenocarcinoma (TCGA)" AS pa_l,
    COALESCE(TRY_CAST(ck."potential prognostic - favorable" AS DOUBLE), TRY_CAST(ck."validated prognostic - favorable" AS DOUBLE)) AS p_k_num,
    COALESCE(TRY_CAST(cl."potential prognostic - favorable" AS DOUBLE), TRY_CAST(cl."validated prognostic - favorable" AS DOUBLE)) AS p_l_num,
    TRY_CAST(regexp_extract(p."Cancer prognostics - Kidney Renal Clear Cell Carcinoma (TCGA)", '\((.+)\)', 1) AS DOUBLE) AS pa_p_k,
    TRY_CAST(regexp_extract(p."Cancer prognostics - Lung Adenocarcinoma (TCGA)", '\((.+)\)', 1) AS DOUBLE) AS pa_p_l
  FROM proteinatlas p
  LEFT JOIN cancer_prognostic_data ck ON p.Ensembl = ck.Gene AND ck.Cancer = 'Kidney Renal Clear Cell Carcinoma (TCGA)'
  LEFT JOIN cancer_prognostic_data cl ON p.Ensembl = cl.Gene AND cl.Cancer = 'Lung Adenocarcinoma (TCGA)'
  WHERE (p."Cancer prognostics - Kidney Renal Clear Cell Carcinoma (TCGA)" LIKE '%prognostic favorable%')
    AND (p."Cancer prognostics - Lung Adenocarcinoma (TCGA)" LIKE '%prognostic favorable%')
)
SELECT 
  Ensembl,
  Gene,
  p_k_num,
  p_l_num,
  GREATEST(p_k_num, p_l_num) AS max_p_num,
  pa_p_k,
  pa_p_l,
  GREATEST(pa_p_k, pa_p_l) AS max_pa_p
FROM genes
ORDER BY max_p_num ASC, Ensembl ASC
LIMIT 15;
